citations.text: Directly inspected the scan pixels. Under the visible headword 三, 白于蓝 describes it as 指事字 and identifies the original sense as the numeral three (“二加一为三”). The passage cites 《庄子·齐物论》, 《广韵·谈韵》, and other received texts for ordinal use and extended use referring broadly to multiplicity. It says the graph used three horizontal strokes to represent quantity; Warring States forms sometimes add 戈 or 弋, and the 弋-added form continued into Han. It distinguishes oracle-bone 三, whose three strokes are equal, from 气, whose middle stroke is shorter. The headword, diagram, paragraph, and paragraph end are visible on this page; page 26 starts with 王 and 皇 entries, not a continuation of 三.
